definitions.action_switch_rate: Changed movement actions divided by adjacent valid decisions in the same live slot/episode; last action carries over rollout boundaries; resets excluded
definitions.advantage_scale: Frozen GAE advantages before per-minibatch normalization; population standard deviation, RMS, mean, extrema and sample count
definitions.clip_fraction: Original PPO sample/minibatch-weighted fraction outside clipping interval.
definitions.early_stop: Final KL strictly above registered target marks a threshold hit. Only epochs_completed<maximum_epochs avoids epochs; a hit on the maximum epoch avoids zero epochs.
definitions.entropy: PPO minibatch/sample-weighted entropy, not frozen-policy rollout entropy
definitions.explained_variance: Original PPO EV uses frozen rollout values and GAE targets; preserve None if PPO reports target population variance<=1e-12. No fabricated zero or CPU recomputation.

required_update_coverage: Every successfully completed update, including valid final partial rollouts; no omitted or duplicate rows. Any update_failure prevents terminal success.
terminal_validator_scope: Warm diagnostic requires registered K1/K4 arms. Recorder supports K1/2/3/4; other campaign terminal validators need their own registered coverage contract.
